Write in **Markdown**, read it formatted, and find any note in seconds.

Everything stays on this device. There’s no account and nothing to sync.

- Tap **New note** to start writing.
- Open a note to read it; tap the pencil to edit.
- Long-press a note for more actions.

### Heading 3

- [x] Already done

> A quote stands out from the text.

Inline `code`, and a fenced block:

```
val results = notes.search(query)
```

[A link](https://commonmark.org) and a bare address: https://spec.commonmark.org

- **Search** finds any word in titles and text, even with only the start of a word.
- **Pin** a note to keep it at the top: long-press it, or use the menu in the note.
- **Import** a .md or .txt file with the import button on the notes list.
- **Export** any note as a Markdown file from its menu.
